g.text: Batch processing | Raw records to governed feature history
Layer 2 · Follow the data path; the bottom rail expands Airflow and DataHub.
Release requires both validation and publication success.
DP1-DP3: bounded source-bound jobs; immutable outputs, persisted-data checks, then release.
Large-source processing ends at Silver; feature engineering/ML use a separate 60-day cohort.
Production dedup keeps the window selector; the slower aggregate candidate was not promoted.
Solid: data files. Dashed: orchestration/metadata. Parquet joins do not enforce SQL foreign keys.
Sources: generator/, pipelines/, airflow/dags/; arrow details link the exact implementation files.
